verdict.rationale: SumUp exposes a managed MCP server and an Agent Toolkit that let AI agents/assistants issue natural-language-driven commands to manage accounts, create checkouts, and process payments, plus llms.txt docs for coding assistants. However, this enables agentic/AI-client access rather than a native natural-language interface within SumUp's own product UI, and there's no independent/hands-on evidence of end-user natural-language command usage. Missing for 10: first-party or independent evidence of a built-in natural-language interface in the SumUp app/dashboard itself, and hands-on validation of the MCP/agent toolkit actually executing NL commands successfully.
